final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias reference: sink 10uA IREF
M8  ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=4 L=1 m=2
* tail current source (40uA)
M5  tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=4 L=1 m=8
* NMOS input pair (vinp = non-inverting)
M1  n1    vinn  tail vss nfet W=12 L=0.5
M2  n2    vinp  tail vss nfet W=12 L=0.5
* PMOS mirror load
M3  n1    n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=16 L=0.8
M4  n2    n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=16 L=0.8
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS sink (280uA)
M6  vout  n2    vdd  vdd pfet W=25 L=0.5 m=5
M7  vout  ibias vss  vss nfet W=4 L=1 m=56
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz  n2    nc    1k
Cc  nc    vout  0.6p
.ends
